prompt: Round 3 of 4. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership of results with the company holding an option to licence, which protects our publishing

content.text:
They moved from uni_owns_option_to_licence with 12 months exclusivity. I want company_owns_uni_academic_use. I can trade: accept uni_owns_option_to_assign (stronger than option_to_licence, closer to ownership) and keep 12 months exclusivity, but push for 18 months exclusivity since I'm giving on IP.

Actually let me think about what's acceptable. My hard limit would be having no path to ownership. uni_owns_option_to_assign gives us the ability to take over the IP, which is close to company ownership. I'll counter with uni_owns_option_to_assign and push exclusivity back to 18 months.
